notes.title: Status Update, Conferences and FAQ!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25216346/48dd8b1bd956878338670c9dbdcd5760af14a5fe.png

Attention Jumpers!

We’ve got news from the H.S.A! The Hive Jump team at Graphite Lab has been keeping busy since the last update. Read below for some news regarding the Wii U platform, conference schedules and some frequently asked questions!

Looking to play Hive Jump on your Wii U? Keep your blasters at the ready… we’re coming soon.

Back in March we sent out a celebratory note to our Kickstarter backers that we’d submitted to Nintendo of America for certification. Our review took a little longer than expected because of a few issues regarding our developer registration. However, thanks to the awesome work of some folks at Nintendo those issues got resolved quickly and we went into review in early April.

Check out our Kickstarter update for more news on that progress! 

FAQ

What is the state of the Steam version? Will there be updates?

The steam version is content complete. Our team is solely focused on Wii U and then physical rewards for our backers in the short term. Our testers have been continuing to review some issues with the multiplayer desyncs and have recently put in some tracking systems which will help us better identify when desyncs occur. Beyond that, we’re still researching options to improve the connectivity and reliability of the online game experience. So we're not done yet, but we don't have things like additional skins or weapons as a priority right now. 

Where are my other rewards?!

Are you a backer wondering about the status of your sweet backer loot? They are in the works! We’ve been delayed by the Wii U progress described above, but are nearly past those issues and should be able to resume work on these very soon. Several of our artists have been compiling art for the art book and jumper guide, we have the hoodies and shirts designed and have new partners for printing selected, too! 

Thanks for being patient and for being an amazing group of fans!

Indy POP CON!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25216346/a57d7c576fa7db78ce6493c0471b9009c75cd37d.jpg

Graphite Lab will be returning to Indy Pop Con July 7 – 9, 2017! Last year we were absolutely shocked to bring home the Top Prize as well as Best Gameplay. We’re proud to be returning so we can celebrate the teams in competition this year!

We’ll have Hive Jump on the show floor, so stop by if you are around and say hi!

Would you like to know more?

As always, please leave us questions and comments below. We love hearing from members of the Jump Corps! If you’d like to get quarterly updates about what Graphite Lab is up to, please sign up here!

notes.title: Tesla Orb Rebalance and Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
Tesla Orb Rebalance and Bug Fixes!(1.00.3861)

ATTENTION JUMPERS! 

We hope you're enjoying Hive Jump and we're continuing to improve the gameplay experience by making some balance tweaks and bug fixes. Community QA testing is ongoing to improve the multiplayer stability of the game as well. Progress is slow on the 1.01 "quality of life" update that will bring Rebindable Controls and other goodies. We thank you for your patience!

Please keep the great feedback and bug reports coming on the Steam forums. Thanks for all your support, and we hope you're all having a blast!

Version 1.00.3861 - Full Change List


  Fix for lag going in and out of relic room doors in Online MP.
  Tesla Orbs now do more damage after bouncing off of surfaces.
  Dropped height of backpack input prompt. 
  Fixed harvester vomit projectiles not colliding with rejuvenation field
  Fix for Crusher's loot being able to be picked up all at once by one player
  Slight graphical improvements to Codex screen glitch screen cover
  Various level design tweaks and fixes
  Harvester's ingest attack does more damage to the backpack now.
  Harvester's ingest attack more reliably grabs the backpack and players. 
  You can no longer hide in the mud in front of the Harvester safely. 
  Backpack temporary invulnerability when drop decreased from 1s to 0.5s
  Improved flamethrower performance.
  Added extra achievements checks for Early Access players.


Give us a Steam review!

Thanks for jumping with us! A positive review on Steam will help bring more Jumpers to our growing community, and result in you having more comrades to jump into hives with!

notes.title: Quality of life patch #1
notes.notes:
Quality of life patch #1! (1.00.3761)

ATTENTION JUMPERS! 

We've got another patch coming in hot! 

We're please to be launching another patch today that should improve the experience of the game for all of our players. We've added some more safety code for online play that should help improve stability, but we know all the desyncs aren't gone yet! 

Keep playing online multiplayer and helping us find the causes of desyncs so we can fix them all! We appreciate your help and will keep at it until all issues are resolved!

Version 1.00.3761 - Full Change List


  [Multiplayer] VSync is now disabled in Online games for avoiding desyncs
  [Multiplayer] LootDropper is now synced by seeding, should help with Desyncs.
  [Addition] Ledge forgiveness ala Spelunky. This helps with Online input-lag for player platforming. 
  [Addition] Pressing left/right on pause menu will cycle through relic descriptions.
  [Balance] Queen has more HP, but so does the nuke. 
  [Addition] Added a Depth display on Pause Menu so you can see how deep you are. 
  [Balance] Lurkers are now colored magenta like other elites, should help visibility in Lava Environment.
  [Balance/Performance] Reduced the fire rate of the incendiary pinwheel grenade
  [Addition] Alert displays at top of screen when hive enters a Swarming state
  [Improvement] "No Jetpack" alerts now display faster when going to a relic room.
  Other misc Art/Sound/Balance improvements not worth mentioning by name.


Give us a Steam review!

Thanks for jumping with us! We're still looking to get over 100 Steam Reviews! A positive review on Steam will help bring more Jumpers to our growing community, and result in you having more comrades to jump into hives with!

notes.title: Multiplayer Stability Mini-Patch (v0.45.2056)
notes.notes:
Progress slow but steady with Online MP stability
Jumpers! Thank you for helping us test the online multiplayer feature! We are aware of issues related to desyncs and some lobby crashes and input freezes. We are working hard to resolve these, but progress is slow. 

Sometimes we fix one aspect, but that solution causes something else to break. We had hoped to include more fixes in this patch for the weekend, but what we have included should help with stability somewhat. Keep testing and let us know how it goes! Submit bug reports from in-game with "F1". Thanks again for your support!

Patch Notes for Version 0.45.2056

    Fixed an issue with desyncing in multiplayer when players used the Chat window while transitioning levels or moving their jumpers in the air.
    PS4 controller input issues fixed.
    Fixes for Daily and Weekly Challenges being non-uniform for all players.
    Other minor fixes


Our immediate focus for production will be solidifying the online multiplayer experience for the majority of our players. This includes:


     Loading screens for the transition from Loadout scene to Hive gameplay.
     Reducing lobby bugs.
     Adding low-end hardware performance settings (this will help multiplayer FPS for all players connected to a low-end machine).
     Finding and fixing any other causes of desyncing. 


After we achieve these goals, we will be able to focus on bringing the game to our other promised platforms, such as Mac and Linux, with cross-platform multiplayer (most likely), and then also adding content such as new aliens, campaign, queen fight, story, and more. 

We'll also be sprinkling in nice-to-have features such as rebind-able controls and other options.

Thanks for sticking with us, and a positive review on Steam will help bring more Jumpers to our growing community! Speaking of which, you can join our Discord community by following this link:  Hive Jump Discord (link good for 24 hours)

Have a great holiday weekend!

https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/430/682/1f80d450f7422a2d3ff923d0d49e536b_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1471643895&auto=format&lossless=true&s=12bc580c2488751049263c09a808a153

Other Fixes

    Confirmed Overshield visuals should reappear after respawning
    Corrected scorcher shield issue
    Repaired instances of "torso splitting"
    Fixed some jumper animations bugs

    Balanced SFX
    Un-broke erroneous environment objects typos


Online Co-op Progress
We are getting even closer with Online Multiplayer through Steam.

https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/013/430/644/13802fb5ebdbe7ae96b19197eacf297d_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1471643607&auto=format&q=92&s=8b94a1b61d7fda5e7738a0b1dcbb0b68

Discord

We've set up a Discord channel for those of you who enjoy that service. Here's the invite link: https://discordapp.com/invite/0brjQ73VCJD2iATW

As always, we welcome comments and questions below.

notes.title: Gameplay Sneak Peek, FAQ Update, Level Building, More Relics, Indy POP CON!
notes.notes:
Attention Jumpers!

We're getting closer to our STEAM EARLY ACCESS DATE (JULY 20!!!) So the updates are going to come a bit more frequently and be a bit lighter. Here's what you have to look forward to in this update:

    Gameplay Sneak Peeks
    FAQ Update
    Level building
    New Relics Located
    Indy POP CON


GAMEPLAY SNEAK PEAK!

The fellers over at  Gooperative Gaming  dropped in to check out the state of the game and do a little raid on the Crusher boss! Check our their video!

http://www.graphitelab.com/hivejump/images/goop.jpg


New Levels, New Modules, New Hazards, Oh My!

https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/012/746/215/ac065173b3c5eb49bf0b5150a8e96361_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1465949462&auto=format&lossless=true&s=d473b85e45d56306d1982d90bbd9c974

One of the game features we've been very proud of since the beginning is our procedural level generation system and level builder tool. This system allows us to build out all of the different stitch-able pieces that make up a playable hive.

We've been working to build more variety into each of our core environments and that means lots and lots of level design for our lead designer Matt Donatelli (@mattdonatelli)! 

We're very excited to jump into these hives with you on July 20th!

New Relics located within the Hive...

https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/012/733/706/cfd72363e5a395ecd5944791e05273f3_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1465860932&auto=format&q=92&s=00f2ae89311bc09761c920c4e4fd2334

Harvester Tail - The tail of a Harvester is heavily armored but has a nub at the end that is soft, pink, and bulbous. This nub is a sensitive weak spot and has a sphincter that opens up to excrete waste and other substances within the Harvester’s body at extreme velocities. These excretions are often covered with the Harvester’s extremely acidic stomach bile. By studying collected Harvester tails, the H.S.A. is developing protective coatings for Jumper armor that resist the extreme acidity of hazards within Ordovician hives.

Jar of Spores - This jar full of hive mushroom spores seems to be the result of experiments by an amateur scientist. The seal on the jar is intact, and the spores within are contained effectively. H.S.A. research has shown that prolonged exposure to non-fatal levels of spores seem to have negative effects on human mental health. In heavy concentrations these spores will cause death by asphyxiation. H.S.A. scientists are hard at work developing filters for Jumper suits and every sample helps.

FAQ Update!

Thanks to everyone who has been mailing,tweeting and messaging questions! We've tried to get answers back to you asap. Here are a few of the most frequently asked questions posed to us since the last update.

(Don't forget you can check out and post on the new steam community hub too!)

Steam only shows support for PC, what about Mac and Linux?

Right now we’re only launching Early Access with a PC build, but we will be staggering Mac and Linux releases throughout the Early Access period in order to address any platform-specific concerns. We anticipate that all platforms will be ready for the final launch at the same time, and that there will be cross-platform multiplayer (although this has yet to be tested and verified).

I may not play a lot of multi-player. Would you say Hive Jump is still enjoyable as a single-player experience?

Most definitely! We've made great strides in developing the single player experience! In addition to normal difficulty scaling features like health / enemy quantity scaling, we’ve also solved other balance issues for one player. For instance, in single-player mode the backpack enters a hover-mode when the player dies, allowing them to re-position the backpack to avoid hazards or enemy fire while waiting to re-spawn. This solved a big issue with player-agency we were having in single-player mode. We're confident single player will be a good experience, and can only get better with the feedback of players who are participating in our Daily "Lone Wolf" Challenges.


Have more questions? Send them our way:  Facebook | Twitter 

Hive Jump is headed to Indy Pop Con!

https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/012/746/143/21062e86b5e0e5a78b8f5dd342ff1ef6_original.jpg?w=639&fit=max&v=1465948840&auto=format&q=92&s=638fc8093f5bb0d8dc4d05f336968cf2

Indy PopCon was founded to celebrate all aspects of pop culture, rather than just hyper focusing on a specific genre. We are stoked to be invited to share Hive Jump at the convention alongside tons of other indie developers, pop culture icons, and other amazing peeps!

Check out the latest demo of Hive Jump on the show floor: Booth #446! Or catch us on the Let's Play stage Friday at 6:00PM!

Would you like to know more?

As always, please feel free to add questions or comments below! Your feedback is important to the team!

Don’t forget to follow us on Facebook and Twitter – and tell your friends about the game!

Facebook | Twitter 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/295670
